{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|Together, Tulak Hord and I devoured our enemies at the battles of Yn and Chabosh and brought the entire Dromund system to its knees. And now I await his return.|Khem Val|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
During the height of his power, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tulak Hord]] '''conquered''' the entire [[Dromund system]] with his [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] warriors. He also used a series of artifacts in a ritual of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]]. Hord's conquest of the Dromund system was considered by Imperial historians to have set the stage for [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] to be the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
